_doc: The test registry (docs/launch/measurement-and-learning-plan.md sections 3.0-3.10, learning build item 7). One entry per pre-registered test; studio/experiments.py loads and validates it (a broken file stops the make and the publish run, nothing is guessed). `status`: on / off. The owner decided on Mon 12 Oct 2026, before any 7-day figure: tests A, B and C on; D and E off; F not decided (off); later the same day, before any data: C off, and G and H (the two edit tests, sections 3.9 and 3.10, version 2) on. A test only assigns from `start` on. What each assignment does at make (studio/drop.py): `tag` (test A) writes `explore_pick` (the clip's score is below the median score of the character's checked drops, ready, being made or made, so the median does not move while a batch is made); `block_coin` writes `test_arms[key]` (a test with `needs_beats`, G and H, skips a master with no beat to follow: no key, no place in its blocks; balanced in blocks of `block`: every arm appears block / len(arms) times, in an order shuffled by a coin seeded from `seed`, the test id, the character and the block number, so each test has its own coin and the coins never line up; the next position of a character is the number of his clips that ever carried the key, whatever became of them, so a position is never given twice); `bandit` (test B) picks the hook among the check's candidates (studio/learn.py). An `off` test assigns nothing. `min_n` and the decisions are the plan's, restated for the weekly digest; they are pre-registered: change them only as a new dated version of the plan, never after the data. Arms of the hook bandit change only by pull request (section 3.3). Owner, Thu 16 Oct 2026, after the first 8 Reels (Lenny's 'When …' hooks led them): Reginald gets the arm `when-relatable` (Franz and Lenny have it), and test B's `lead` puts `when-relatable` first for the next 2 clips of Franz and of Reginald made from that day (studio/learn.py, `lead_of`; a failed, rejected or dropped clip gives its place back; the clips are bandit draws like any other).

A.name: score and exploration picks
A.question: does a higher score_total go with a higher outlier_x (Spearman rho above 0)?

B.name: hook bandit
B.question: which hook pattern gets more views at 72 h (x72 above 1), per character?
B.win: x72 above 1 on the Instagram post

C.name: Trial Reels on half the Instagram posts
C.question: does a Trial Reel get more views in 72 h than a normal Reel on an account under 1,000 followers, without cutting follows?

D.name: own series against swaps
D.question: do the character's own episodes reach at least 0.8x the swaps' median outlier_x and bring more follows per 1K?
D.note: off (owner 12 Oct 2026): it costs credits (a Recreate is 160)

E.name: 8-10 s against 12-15 s
E.question: does a 12-15 s clip reach 1.3x the median outlier_x of an 8-10 s clip at a cost per 1K views no more than 20 % worse?
E.note: off (owner 12 Oct 2026): about +500 credits, and it goes against 8-10 s for non-classics

F.name: first comment: vote or question
F.question: does a vote get more viewer comments per 1K views than an open question?
F.note: off: the first comment is not posted within 5 minutes and pinned yet (plan Task 8), so the precondition is not met

G.name: zoom pulses on the beat
G.question: does a punch-in (zoom_hit 1.06) on every 4th beat, picture only, reach 1.3x the median outlier_x of a master without pulses?
G.eligible: masters with beats (the clip's own audio or ai_beat); a silent in_app master, or a clip with no sound, takes no position
G.note: otherwise no pulses (the default wins ties); a master with beats 0 is left out of both arms, so is arm on with zoom_pulses 0; secondary, report only: x72, skip rate, watched %; no credits (ffmpeg only)

H.name: the first hook pops in word by word on the beat
H.question: does the first hook coming in one word per beat (word_pop) reach 1.3x the median outlier_x of the character's own kit entrance?
H.eligible: masters with beats (the clip's own audio or ai_beat); a silent in_app master, or a clip with no sound, takes no position
H.note: otherwise the kits' own entrances (the default wins ties); a master with beats 0 is left out of both arms, so is arm on with hook_entrance not word_pop; secondary, report only: x72, skip rate, watched %; no credits (PIL and ffmpeg only)
